newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Cuba plans to set up mission in Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Cuba plans to set up mission in Malaysia.

text.p: Cuba has proposed the setting up of a diplomatic mission in Malaysia, a move welcomed by Kuala Lumpur, Malaysian Foreign Minister Abdullah Ahmad Badawi said on Friday.
Abdullah was quoted by the national news agency Bernama as saying he was informed of Cuba's proposal during talks with visiting Cuban Foreign Minister Roberto Robaina Gonzalez.
At present, Cuba's ambassador to Laos is also accredited to Malaysia while Malaysia's dealings with Cuba are handled by its mission in the United States.
Foreign Ministry officials were not available for comment.
Abdullah said Cuba was keen to share its experience with Malaysia in various areas such as development, poverty eradication, plantations and rural development.
Gonzalez also extended an invitation from Cuban President Fidel Castro to Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad to visit Cuba, Abdullah said.
Gonzalez arrived on Wednesday for a five-day visit to Malaysia.
